ns2:course.label: Drawing I
ns2:course.description: Theory and practice in observational drawing with emphasis on fundamental principles such as mark/line, shape/form, space/composition, linear/perspective, scale/proportion, value/tonal range, and pattern/texture. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule.Prerequisite: Open to Art and Design majors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule.Prerequisite: Open to Art and Design majors only.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Foundation or New Media major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Personal supply cost is about $60 plus additional Class Materials fee. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
